items.prompt: A nearly empty airport terminal at five in the morning. An elderly lady in a small hat with a little veil, seen from behind at a slight angle, sits on a bench hugging a cake box on her knees. Farther off, small and from behind, a man in a dark jacket and the woman, about forty, shoulder-length dark hair, a light raincoat, stand side by side with a small wheeled suitcase. Dark glass, long reflections on the floor, unlit blank boards.

alt.ru: Пустой терминал в пять утра: пожилая дама в шляпе с вуалеткой обнимает коробку с тортом, вдали спиной к нам стоят двое с чемоданом.
alt.en: An empty terminal at five in the morning: an elderly lady in a hat with a little veil hugs a cake box, two people with a suitcase stand far off with their backs to us.
alt.pt: Um terminal vazio às cinco da manhã: uma senhora de chapéu com véu abraça uma caixa de bolo, ao longe duas pessoas de costas com uma mala.
alt.es: Una terminal vacía a las cinco de la mañana: una señora mayor con sombrero de velo abraza una caja de tarta, al fondo dos personas de espaldas con una maleta.

caption.ru: До паспортного контроля сорок минут. Дама в шляпе везёт торт.
caption.en: Forty minutes to passport control. The lady in the hat is taking a cake with her.
caption.pt: Faltam quarenta minutos para o controle de passaportes. A senhora de chapéu leva um bolo.
caption.es: Quedan cuarenta minutos para el control de pasaportes. La señora del sombrero lleva una tarta.

items.prompt: Airport passport control at dawn, seen from a distance behind a waiting man in a dark jacket, his back to us. At the counter the woman, about forty, shoulder-length dark hair, a light raincoat, a shoulder bag with a torn zip and the corner of a book showing, is half turned back toward him, her face indistinct in soft focus. Behind the counter glass a border officer bends over an open passport. A little to the side, unnoticed on the floor by the next counter, sits a black poodle. Behind the booth a frosted glass partition.

alt.ru: Паспортный контроль: женщина с сумкой стоит у стойки, мужчина спиной к нам смотрит ей вслед, у соседней стойки сидит чёрный пудель.
alt.en: Passport control: a woman with a shoulder bag stands at the counter, a man with his back to us watches her, a black poodle sits by the next counter.
alt.pt: Controle de passaportes: uma mulher de bolsa está no guichê, um homem de costas para nós a observa, junto ao guichê vizinho está sentado um poodle preto.
alt.es: Control de pasaportes: una mujer con bolso está en el mostrador, un hombre de espaldas a nosotros la mira, junto al mostrador de al lado hay un caniche negro.

caption.ru: В пять утра в аэропорту никто не смотрит ниже чужого чемодана. Пуделя видел я один.
caption.en: At five in the morning in an airport nobody looks lower than somebody else's suitcase. Only I saw the poodle.
caption.pt: Às cinco da manhã num aeroporto ninguém olha abaixo da mala alheia. Só eu vi o poodle.
caption.es: A las cinco de la mañana en un aeropuerto nadie mira más abajo de la maleta ajena. Solo yo vi al caniche.
